title: Absorb
text: We’ve finally reached the border fortress of the country we’re passing through on our way to Siltvelt. We’re currently observing the fortress from a distance through the woods.
“What do you think?”
At first glance, it looks like merchants are passing through the fortress as usual. I don’t sense anything suspicious, but Éclair furrowed her brow and muttered,

“At first glance, it doesn’t seem out of the ordinary… but something’s off. There are guards on the watchtowers, which is odd. And isn’t there more people inside the fortress than usual? I can just barely make them out through the windows.”

I checked the spots Éclair pointed out. Indeed… now that she mentions it, there do seem to be an unusually large number of people. It’s not quite as bad as when my Father was on the wanted list before the loop, but it’s still quite a lot.
“I-is that so?”
“To think it’s just my Ki… that would be too much of a stretch.”
Éclair muttered that. The envoy from Siltvelt nodded in agreement as well.
“How about transferring him to a cart, hiding the Shield Hero, and passing through that way?”
“Smuggling him out of the country… I don’t think it’s a bad idea, but considering Lord Iwatani’s current level, it’d be quite dangerous if he were discovered.”
“True, they’ll probably search the cargo very thoroughly.”
“That’s right… What should we do?”
My fathers are discussing it, looking troubled. This is exactly the kind of situation where Motoyasu steps in!
“Then I’ll go ahead and check things out, so everyone else should stay hidden.”
“Huh? Motoyasu-kun, are you going alone? Isn’t that dangerous?”
I, Motoyasu, have truly taken my father-in-law’s sincerity to heart. I felt tears welling up inside me like a waterfall.
“M-Motoyasu!? Why are you crying?”
“It’s nothing. I’m just deeply moved by Father’s kindness!”
“Did I say something that weird!?”
For some reason, Éclair let out a sigh.
“Mr. Iwatani, I’m starting to think it might be time for you to get used to Mr. Kitamura’s eccentric behavior.”
“Ah… yeah. That’s true, but I was just wondering if it’s really okay to let him go alone.”
“I don’t think that’s a problem. After all, even from my perspective, Mr. Kitamura possesses unfathomable strength… though his personality is just as unfathomable.”

I couldn’t quite make out Éclair’s last remark. It seems my Father heard it, though, as he’s nodding in agreement. Come to think of it, I feel like my Father used to whisper with Big Sister quite often. I found it unpleasant when they first started whispering, but looking back now, I realize it must have been important. Probably.
“Rather than sending Motoyasu alone, wouldn’t it be safer for all of us to force our way through?”

“I do think that’s one option, too. But from what I’ve heard, Lord Kitamura’s teleportation ability lets him travel to places he’s been before, right? If that’s the case, once we’ve safely passed through the fortress, we can just have him specify a teleportation point and come back.”
“I see! It wouldn’t make sense to target me if Motoyasu-kun can get through anyway.”
That’s true—that’s a viable option. It seems portals accumulate even in the next loop, so if there is a next loop, let’s make use of this method.
“All we have to do is protect Lord Iwatani until Lord Kitamura resolves the situation without being detected.”
“Understood.”

The envoy from Siltvelt is nodding as well. It pains me to be separated from my Father, even if only temporarily, but now is the time for battle! Let’s call this the Battle of Melromarc Fortress. I’ll show Father the results of my victory and prove just how loyal a subject I am.
“Well then, I’m off. If anything happens, just give a conspicuous signal and I’ll rush right over.”
“Okay.”
“Leave it to me.”
And so, I set off alone on foot toward the border fortress.
As I walked toward the border, I saw the sentries start to stir. Soldiers began pouring out of the fortress in droves.
“You’re the Spear Hero! Where is the Shield Demon?”

Speaking on behalf of the soldiers… it was the Captain of the Knight Order—I’m pretty sure we’d crossed paths a few times back in the First World—who shouted the question. He’d disappeared at some point, so what on earth is he doing here?
“I have no idea. More importantly, I need to pass through here.”
“Who’s going to let you through! Tell us where the Demon of the Shield is! Otherwise…”

The soldiers capable of Magic began chanting Ceremonial Magic from the rear. I could feel a high-density Magical Power field forming around us. That’s something I learned around the time I gained the ability to boost my energy.
“Come on! It’s in your best interest to just tell us.”
“Who do you think is going to tell you?”

It seems certain that the people here were the ones who killed my Father during the first loop. It’s safe to assume that the envoy from Siltvelt also tried to pass through normally but was spotted and killed by the people here. Before the loop, my Father hadn’t fled to another country or anything like that. That’s probably why he survived… I suppose they really don’t want my father to go to Siltvelt.
“I’ll say it one more time. Let me through, or I’ll kill you. If you let me through, I won’t kill you.”
“Hmph. You fool! You fake spearman! Brace yourself! Attack!”
“‘Ceremonial Magic: “Judgment—”’”

I was casting a certain type of Magic I’d learned from my Father while we spoke. As long as a spellcaster of a considerably high rank—someone on the level of my Big Sister’s older sister—isn’t directing it, even Ceremonial Magic should be able to handle it.

“I, The Love Hunter, command the heavens and command the earth; I shall sever the order of things, reconnect them, and force out the pus. O power of the Dragon Vein. Unite with my Magical Power and the Hero’s strength; The Love Hunter, the very source of power, commands: Interpret all things in the universe once more, absorb the power of darkness, and transform it into strength!”
“Al Liberation Absorb X!”

As the spell was completed, I raised my spear toward the heavens. Ceremonial Magic summoned a massive raincloud, and with a clap of thunder, a colossal bolt of lightning struck straight toward me. This was likely the attack that killed my father in the previous loop.

Before I knew it, I was clenching my back teeth with a grinding sound. While my current father is indeed safe, the one from the previous loop perished right here. Therefore, I must pay my respects to him.
“Hahaha! You foolish imposter of the Spear!”
The Captain of the Knight Order is laughing loudly. So I, too, flash a smirk at them. The moment the lightning struck me—Magical Power was swiftly drawn into the spear.
“Hahahaha… Huh!?”
I can feel the Magical Power coursing through my body. Since I rarely use Magic to begin with, simply healing myself is pointless.
“W-What nonsense! ‘Judgment’ vanishes as if it never happened… you say!?”

The Captain of the Knight Order glared at me with a look of disbelief. How utterly foolish. His defeat was sealed the moment he chose to oppose my Father. These foolish, incompetent fools need to be judged.
“You’ve greatly underestimated the power of the Hero. Dealing with something of this caliber is no trouble at all.”
Well, it’s no fun to waste the Magical Power I’ve just recovered. Since it’ll be gone in a little while anyway, I’ll deal with them using Magic rather than Skills.

‘I, The Love Hunter, command the heavens and the earth; I sever and reconnect the order of things, and force out the pus. O power of the Dragon Vein. Unite with my Magical Power and the Hero’s power; The Love Hunter, the very source of all power, commands: Decipher the workings of the universe once more, and sweep away this foolish horde with a storm of flames!”
“W-what are you doing! Hurry up and kill that impostor with the spear!”
The Captain of the Knight Order declared pompously, and the soldiers let out a roar as they charged toward me. But it’s already too late.
“Liberation Firestorm V!”

I repositioned the spear in my left hand, formed the Magic with my right, and unleashed it forward. A massive fiery tornado erupted from my right hand. And it’s Liberation—the most powerful Magic, learned from my Father, that only a hero can use.
“W-what is that!?”
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
“Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”

Screams and shouts echoed throughout the area as the kingdom’s soldiers were swallowed up by the fiery storm. Even the Captain of the Knight Order was no exception; he tried to use the soldiers as a shield to escape, but it was already too late—he was swept away by the rapidly moving tornado. Eventually, with a clattering roar, the storm of flames swept through the fortress and dissipated.
“Well, I suppose that’s about it.”
Not even a trace of the fortress remains. With this, those fools should have understood: picking a fight with Father equals death.
“That was a warning—I went easy on them. You’d better be grateful for the Shield Hero’s mercy.”
“Ugh… ugh…”

Charred soldiers rained down, leaving the area littered with corpses. I have no idea where the Captain of the Knight Order is. Since I went easy on them, I don’t think there are that many casualties. I stomped on the chest of a soldier lying nearby, on the verge of death, and declared:
“This is your punishment for trying to kill the Shield Hero. Tell that Trash king and the Pope. If you don’t want to die, don’t go sticking your nose in… heh heh heh heh heh!”

Just as I was cackling like that, for some reason, the carriage carrying my Father and Éclair and the others came galloping toward us. Their expressions seemed to be painted with the word “confusion.”
“I saw a giant fiery tornado, so I rushed over… but what on earth is this…?”
“Weren’t we supposed to stay hidden until it was safe?”
“Lord Iwatani was worried.”
“What! I’m so moved, Motoyasu, I’m tearing up—”
“Enough of that! Did Motoyasu-kun do this?”
“That’s right.”
“A Hero… can they really become this strong!?”

My father is speechless. What on earth is he saying? Someone like him should be able to accomplish even more incredible feats with complete composure. In fact, he’s overcome situations like this countless times, always protecting his comrades.
I miss the battle against the Pope. My father even protected me—even though I was his enemy. And yet, I kept speaking ill of him afterward… If I could go back in time, I’d kill my past self. Oh?
“There are… dead bodies, right? Aren’t we going a bit too far?”
“When I checked from a distance, the Captain of the Knight Order was there. That means he was probably trying to kill Lord Iwatani.”
“You’ve got to brush off the sparks that fly your way, or you’ll get burned! Come on, let’s move on to the next one.”

“U-uh… Actually, I think Motoyasu-kun might be the scariest person here. You know how in manga there’s that line, ‘I’m glad he’s on our side’? I guess that’s exactly the kind of situation where you’d use it.”
What are you saying, Father? There’s not a shred of sympathy needed for these people, who likely cast Ceremonial Magic at you during the last loop.
“Come on, let’s get going!”
And so, we managed to safely cross the border.
